what: Failover drill (reviews of October 2026, H-01): writes at 20 a second through HAProxy configured by deploy/production/db/proxy.sh (the db proxy), the primary killed without warning (kill -9 of its Patroni and its PostgreSQL), the synchronous standby promoted by Patroni.
where: Development host, 10 October 2026: native etcd 3.5 (three members, TLS with client certificates, environment from the bundles deploy/production/init.sh writes), Patroni 4.0.6 with deploy/production/db/patroni.yml (REST API over HTTPS), PostgreSQL 16 with pg_hba.conf as masslak-db-entry writes it, HAProxy 2.8; zero data loss off (with it on and two hosts, writes wait for the lost host). The old primary then rejoined as the synchronous standby by pg_rewind.
